_about: Read by scripts/demo/guard.mjs. Commit this file: it holds identifiers, not secrets. The guard refuses to run while either value is still a placeholder.
_connectionEnv: Names of environment variables that hold connection strings. Each one that is set must identify demo and must not mention production.
_secretEnv: Names of environment variables that hold keys. Each one that is set is searched for a production value. Values are never printed.
_seedEmailDomains: Extra domains seed files may use for invented accounts, beyond the reserved ones (example.com, .test, .invalid). List only a domain you own that cannot receive mail, such as a demo subdomain with no MX record.
